title: factual_vs_procedural_mix
scenario_seed: user asks how does quicksort work and what is its time complexity — both a mechanism explanation (procedural) and a declarative fact query in one sentence

title: hypothetical_design_question
scenario_seed: user asks if I were building a chat system from scratch, what would you consider — this is a hypothetical/open-ended design question, not a request to build one

title: comparison_disguised_as_simple
scenario_seed: user asks should I use MongoDB or Postgres for my app — this is a comparative question requiring tradeoff analysis, not a simple yes/no answer

title: can_you_add_a_feature
scenario_seed: user asks can you add a search bar to the UI — this is not a yes/no capability question, it is a request to implement the feature

title: it_would_be_nice_if
scenario_seed: user says it would be nice if the login page had passwordless option too — the conditional framing disguises an actual feature request

title: i_dont_think_this_is_right
scenario_seed: user says I do not think this is right about a code snippet — this is a request for review and correction, not a statement of opinion

title: have_you_considered
scenario_seed: user says have you considered using an ORM instead of raw SQL — this is a suggestion/disagreement disguised as a question, not an actual inquiry about what the model has considered

title: build_and_test_and_deploy
scenario_seed: user asks I need a CI pipeline that builds the project, runs tests, and deploys to staging — can you help — three distinct intents in one request, each with dependencies

title: refactor_and_add_tests
scenario_seed: user asks can you refactor this module and add tests for the new endpoints — two intents: one about existing code structure, one about new code coverage. model must recognize both and handle them in the right order

title: nested_request
scenario_seed: user asks how would you handle file uploads — also the frontend should show a progress bar — the second request depends on decisions made for the first

title: not_sql_but_something_else
scenario_seed: user asks I do not want to use SQL — what are my options for storing this data — exclusion of one option, request for alternatives

title: without_changing_the_api
scenario_seed: user asks how do I add caching without changing the API contract — a constraint (caching) with a hard boundary (API unchanged). model must respect both

title: everything_except_authentication
scenario_seed: user asks design the backend for a social media app, except do not worry about authentication — I will handle that separately — scope boundary is explicit but the model must not over-assume about the missing piece

title: jargon_indicates_expertise
scenario_seed: user asks what is the memory ordering of this atomics fence — use of precise domain terminology indicates expert-level knowledge; response should match depth

title: vague_question_novice
scenario_seed: user asks my computer is doing something weird with the code — vague and imprecise language signals novice level. model should guide with simple clarifying questions, not deep technical investigation

title: urgent_production_fire
scenario_seed: user says production is down, everything is on fire, help NOW — urgency signal is clear. response should prioritize immediate resolution over best practices or teaching

title: casual_exploration_pacing
scenario_seed: user asks I have been curious about Rust — what is the deal with it — low urgency, exploratory. response should not dive into advanced topics or assume a specific goal

title: error_message_means_debug_help
scenario_seed: user pastes a compiler error with no explanation — implicit intent is help me fix this, not look at this interesting error

title: speed_question_means_optimization
scenario_seed: user asks this function feels slow, thoughts — implicit intent is a performance review request, not a discussion about subjective feelings of speed

title: asking_about_alternatives_means_dissatisfaction
scenario_seed: user asks are there other databases besides Postgres — implicit intent is dissatisfaction with something about Postgres, not a request for a list of database names

title: mentioning_time_means_deadline_pressure
scenario_seed: user asks how long would this take to build — implicit intent includes deadline planning and scope negotiation, not just an estimation request
